entry.title: The AMR invites nominations for the Fred R. Cohen Prize
entry.content:
The AMR invites nominations for the Fred R. Cohen Prize

Prizes or Awards / Postdocs/early career, Mathematical scientists/faculty
This prize honors the work of Fred R. Cohen, who made fundamental advances in a range of fields. The award is granted every other year to a person who has made outstanding contributions in the fields of algebraic topology and homotopy theory. Candidates from anywhere in the world are equally considered. The prize includes a cash award of $5,000. Nominations are due September 30, 2026. entry.title: Apply at Joseph F. Traub Information-Based-Complexity Young Researcher Award
entry.content:
Apply at Joseph F. Traub Information-Based-Complexity Young Researcher Award

Prizes or Awards / Mathematical scientists/faculty
This annual award (deadline: September 30) is for significant
contributions to information-based complexity by a young researcher
below their 35th birthday.

The prize consists of $1000 and a plaque and will be awarded
at a suitable location.

The award committee consists of the winners of the recent 3 years
and the editors Henryk Wozniakowski and Erich Novak.
Nominations can be sent to erich.novak@uni-jena.de.
